description: A custom LinearLayout subclass that manages a stream of card views with swipe-to-dismiss and animations, used in an Android application for displaying a dynamic list of cards with interactive behaviors.

classes.name: CardStreamLinearLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that manages a stream of dismissible card views with swipe gestures, animations, and hierarchy change handling for an Android app.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a new card view to the layout with an option to make it dismissible.

methods.name: addView
methods.description: Overrides default addView to initialize cards with dismissible property.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Handles layout changes, sets up transition animations, and triggers initial animations if needed.

methods.name: isSwiping
methods.description: Determines if the user's movement indicates a swipe action based on movement thresholds.

methods.name: swipeView
methods.description: Updates the position and rotation of a card view during a swipe gesture.

methods.name: notifyOnDismissEvent
methods.description: Notifies a listener when a card has been dismissed.

methods.name: getFirstVisibleCardTag
methods.description: Returns the tag of the first visible card in the layout.

methods.name: setFirstVisibleCard
methods.description: Sets the first visible card in the layout, scrolling to it if layout is already done.

methods.name: triggerShowInitialAnimation
methods.description: Flags the layout to run initial animations after layout is complete.

methods.name: setCardStreamAnimator
methods.description: Sets a custom animator object for preparing swipe and appearance animations.

methods.name: setOnDismissListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for dismiss events when cards are swiped out.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initial setup of attributes, including animation speed and animator configuration.

methods.name: initCard
methods.description: Initializes a card view by resetting its animation state and setting touch listener.

methods.name: isFixedView
methods.description: Checks whether a given view is fixed (non-dismissible).

methods.name: resetAnimatedView
methods.description: Resets the view's transformation properties to default states.

methods.name: runInitialAnimations
methods.description: Runs entrance animations on child views at startup if configured.

methods.name: runShowActionAreaAnimation
methods.description: Animates the action area of a card to appear with a rotation and fade-in effect.

methods.name: handleViewSwipingOut
methods.description: Animates and removes a card view when dismissed, notifying listener.

methods.name: handleViewSwipingIn
methods.description: Animates a card back to original position if a swipe is canceled.

methods.name: scrollToCard
methods.description: Scrolls the parent ScrollView to bring the specified card tag into view.
